# YoniDev — Yonatan Yaglnik

> Yonatan Yaglnik (YoniDev) is a Full-Stack developer from Jerusalem, Israel.
> He builds modern web applications, AI integrations, automations, and bots —
> taking products from idea to production. Available for freelance work
> worldwide (remote) and in Israel.

YoniDev is the personal brand and portfolio site of Yonatan Yaglnik.
Primary site language is Hebrew (he-IL); content is also available in English.
Contact: yonidev0101@gmail.com

## Core pages
- [Home](https://yonidev.vercel.app/): overview, services, featured projects
- [About](https://yonidev.vercel.app/about): background, story, current work
- [Services](https://yonidev.vercel.app/services): Full-Stack, AI, automation, bots, APIs
- [Projects](https://yonidev.vercel.app/projects): case studies and portfolio
- [Contact](https://yonidev.vercel.app/contact): contact form and channels

## Featured projects
- [Yoniverse OS](https://yonidev.vercel.app/projects/yoniverse): personal AI operating system spanning desktop, mobile, web, WhatsApp, smart home — orchestrated by a central AI Brain server
- [al-hamacom702](https://yonidev.vercel.app/projects/al-hamacom): Hebrew community portal for Jerusalem neighborhoods with semantic AI search, payments, real estate, classifieds, forum
- [AI WhatsApp Business Bot](https://yonidev.vercel.app/projects/ai-whatsapp-bot): bot that remembers business chat history and answers Hebrew questions about it using vector search + Claude/GPT
- [Categories Game](https://yonidev.vercel.app/projects/categories-game): real-time multiplayer Hebrew word game with AI-judged answers
- [GitExplorer](https://yonidev.vercel.app/projects/git-explorer): native desktop file explorer with full Git client (Tauri + Rust + React)

## Tech stack
Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Tauri, Rust, MongoDB, Socket.IO,
OpenAI (GPT-4o, embeddings, Whisper), Anthropic Claude, Tailwind CSS.
